extracted.intended_audience: Navy claimants, base/command managers, contracting officers, QAEs, OPNAV-443 staff, and others responsible for implementing and overseeing the Navy Commercial Activities (CA) program (post-award and program management)
extracted.subtask_description: Recommendations, performance criteria, data/measurement rules, training requirements, and procedural standards for post-award management and evaluation of Navy Commercial Activities (CA) contracts, including Quality Assurance, mobilization readiness, cost accounting, and program-level measurement of savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Site visits tied to significant milestones
rubrics_metrics.description: Visits should coincide with significant milestones in the process such as writing the PWS, forming the MEO, conducting the cost comparison, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purpose: allow the activity undergoing the process to benefit from 'lessons learned' at other activities and develop real-life claimant-level expertise based on experience rather than instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish periodic 'Lessons Learned' synopsis
rubrics_metrics.description: Publish a synopsis of 'Lessons Learned' about the CA program on a periodic basis and distribute it widely throughout the claimancy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Solicit regular inputs from activities that have undergone the process and submit a recap of these lessons to OPNAV-443 on an annual basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-transition command meeting (60-90 days)
rubrics_metrics.description: Convene and chair a command meeting at those commands who will transition to a contractor operation about 60-90 days prior to the transition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Solicit support from CO, XO, Department Heads; introduce key command personnel; have them highlight contract specifications and possible problem areas; request follow-up meeting with Dept Heads and other activities to discuss concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish a Quality Assurance Manual for claimants
rubrics_metrics.description: Claimants publish a Quality Assurance Manual similar to the one published by NAVFAC to assist commands that have transitioned to contractor operations in establishing and conducting their Quality Assurance programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manual should contain policy guidelines on sampling techniques, sample checklists, measurement issues, etc.; be a 'how to' publication easily used by QAEs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish QAE training courses / obtain training quotas
rubrics_metrics.description: In conjunction with Quality Assurance manuals, claimants establish QAE training courses or obtain quotas from other claimancies offering such courses for each of their commands that will transition to a contractor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure QAEs receive hands-on and standardized training tied to the manual and inspection/sample techniques.

rubrics_metrics.name: OPNAV-443 instruction on post-award conversion issues
rubrics_metrics.description: OPNAV-443 issue an instruction dealing with the post-award issues of converting to a contract operation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction should outline options for dealing with contractor performance problems including basic guidance on forming contingency plans and operations, and consider streamlining government personnel recruiting/detailing procedures and temporary contractor onboarding procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish central contingency fund at OPNAV-443
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish a central contingency fund at OPNAV-443 to financially assist commands that must assemble a contingency operation due to poor contractor performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows activity to rid itself of deficient contractors until resolicitation; provides OPNAV-443 management visibility of costs associated with poor contractor performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit/research PWS adequacy for complex/multi-function operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Conduct audits/research on complex operations and multi-function contracts to determine the overall adequacy of the PWSs in these situations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Based on findings, re-evaluate/eliminate some complex operations from CA inventory or determine how the PWS was written well; consider funding resources during cost comparison for PWS preparation; develop CA functional experts at claimant level to assist with PWS preparation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence CA reviews from simple to complex
rubrics_metrics.description: Task base commanders with scheduling CA reviews such that the simplest CA functions are reviewed first and the sequence moves from simpler to more complex ones.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows development of expertise in PWS preparation at the activity before attempting complex operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish annual list of commands by functional area
rubrics_metrics.description: OPNAV-443 publish an annual list of the commands that have undergone CA reviews sorted by functional area and distribute to major claimants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Major claimants disseminate the list so commands can contact others that have undergone reviews in the same functional area to access 'proven' PWSs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve availability/publicity of PWS training
rubrics_metrics.description: Improve availability and/or publicity of the PWS Preparation training courses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make training more accessible to commands preparing PWSs to improve performance definition quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Require contract mobilization contingency plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Require a mobilization contingency plan as a part of the original contract.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Require periodic updating of the plan as part of normal contract report requirements to minimize risks of contractor performance during mobilization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Periodic mobilization drills with contractor
rubrics_metrics.description: Commands conduct periodic 'mobilization drills' with the contractor similar to those conducted by the Reserves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Drills test adequacy of mobilization plans and readiness of contractor support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include mobilization in contract form selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Include mobilization considerations when determining contract form and evaluating need for support function coordination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize multi-function contracts may be easier to coordinate and administer during mobilization periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish special AG/SAG and Cost Account Codes for contractor ops
rubrics_metrics.description: NAVCOMPT establish a special Activity Group/Sub-Activity Group (AG/SAG) code for Base Contractor Operations and separate Cost Account Codes (CAC) for contract administration, contract operations and contract administration clerical support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables separate identification of private sector functions and government support, accumulation of actual cost data, and establishment of historical cost database for better cost estimates and program monitoring.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study cost accounting and standard cost factors
rubrics_metrics.description: Conduct additional studies on the Navy's cost accounting system and assess the current policy of using standard cost factors for indirect costs in the cost comparison process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on rationale/basis for standard cost factors and research on inconsistency between cost factor used for accelerating fringe/retirement benefits in budget formulation and factor used in CA Cost Comparison process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish actual cost database for contract administration
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish an actual cost data base for contract administration based upon revisions to the Cost Accounting system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Revise the Cost Comparison Handbook to reflect higher contract administration staffs where necessary; allow more accurate staffing/cost estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design contracts to accommodate budget reductions
rubrics_metrics.description: Design/tailor contracts to consider budget reductions by establishing a baseline contract and price that can be scaled down to reduced versions with 60-90 days notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include modifications representing reduced operations in the original contract package and require price quote on reduced services as part of original bid to reduce later negotiation costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tailor procurement method to operation complexity
rubrics_metrics.description: Require that all complex and multi-function operations use negotiated (or the two-step) procurement method.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporate this requirement into OPNAVINST 4860.7B; negotiated procedures better suit complex or poorly defined operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluate contract type for complex/multi-function contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Conduct a systematic evaluation of the desirability of using a Cost Plus Award Fee Contract for complex and multi-function contracts versus Firm Fixed Price (FFP) contracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General contracting guidelines indicate FFP contracts are not well-suited for complex or poorly defined systems or operations; evaluate suitability carefully.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider multi-function contracts at high-inventory activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Claimants give serious consideration to requiring multi-function contracts versus single function contracts at activities having a large inventory of CA operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Potential benefits include easier coordination/admin during mobilization and overall management efficiencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specialized contracting officer training for CA
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized training for Contracting Officers who will be administering CA contracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training should concentrate on appropriate contracting techniques, methods and procedures, and include in-depth options for dealing with contractor performance problems specifically related to CA functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical training for QAEs
rubrics_metrics.description: Statistical training for QAEs, particularly random sampling techniques and other sampling techniques appropriate to monitoring service (vice production) operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equip QAEs to apply correct sampling methodologies for service-type contracts and quality surveillance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training on performance measurement and quality surveillance
rubrics_metrics.description: Training on performance measurement and conducting quality surveillance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure personnel monitoring contracts understand performance metrics, measurement systems, and surveillance techniques.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase publicity and offerings of CA courses/tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Increased publicity and offerings of CA courses/tools already in existence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically publicize automated Cost Comparison software developed at CNET and Cost Comparison and PWS Preparation courses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Systematic collection of program management data
rubrics_metrics.description: Routine program management data should be systematically collected; management reviews and audits of the program should be increased.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Better data collection and independent/post-award reviews would improve program debates and inform policy; additional studies/research are needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify areas for further CA research
rubrics_metrics.description: Topics surfaced for additional study include: performance effectiveness and cost savings attributable to functions that remained in-house after CA review; evaluation of Navy cost accounting and CA post-award control system; use of Standard Cost vs Actual Cost in Cost Comparison; ROI assessment of CA program versus other efficiency measures; comparison of effectiveness of FFP vs Cost Plus Award Fee for CA functions; which CA functional areas succeed under contractor; dealing with budget flexibility; private sector subcontract management techniques applicability; contractor mobilization ability; methodology for Government Employees' Fringe Benefits/Retirement Cost Factor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use research findings to inform future policy, cost comparison methodology, and program design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compute in-house (MEO) savings rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Savings are computed based on the number of positions eliminated by implementation of the Most Efficient Organization (MEO).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Savings are calculated for 3 years (length of average cost comparison). Savings ($) are calculated for each position eliminated using the 'cost per position' used in the NAVCOMPT Budget Exhibit OP-03 for the appropriate fiscal years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compute conversion-to-contract savings rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Two types of savings when function goes to contract: (1) MEO Savings (computed as above) and (2) Conversion Savings — difference between in-house and contract bids.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conversion savings are calculated for the period covered by the cost comparison (usually 3 years).

rubrics_metrics.name: Program expense definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Program expense equals the salary costs of dedicated CA administrative positions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include these expenses when calculating net program savings and payback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance assessment checklist (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria used to judge contractor performance (questionnaire): Observation; Routine Command Performance indicators; Timeliness measures; Accuracy measures; Safety measures; Customer satisfaction measures; External inspection results; Internal audit results; Quality Assurance inspection results; Other (specify).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use multiple measures to assess contractor performance; allow checking multiple applicable criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: T801: Storage and warehousing performance metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific storage/warehousing metrics to collect before and after contract award: Receipt-to-stow on-time (%); Issues on-time (%); Warehouse refusals (%); Shipped on-time (%); Receipt accuracy (%); Issue accuracy (%); Ability to meet emergency requirements; General Warehouse Appearance (cleanliness); Local Deliveries On-time; # Safety Violations (documented); # Incoming Reports of Discrepancy (RODs); % Items Properly Packed for Shipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect metrics both before and after award to evaluate contractor performance and operational impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: S713: Food service operations performance metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Food service metrics to collect: Sanitation Inspection Results; Equipment Maintenance; Financial Returns (Over or Under issue); Cycle Menu Development; Customer Satisfaction Indicators; Attendance Levels; # Safety Violations (documented).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect before/after data to assess changes attributable to contracting out.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of deductions and deficiency reporting as enforcement metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Track whether deductions for substandard performance were taken (yes/no), number of deductions, average monthly amount, cumulative amount, and what performance areas were deficient.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also record other actions taken (Contract Deficiency Reports, litigation, claims) to measure enforcement and remediation activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-award survey and technical proposal evaluation practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Record whether a pre-award survey was conducted, who performed it and what was done; whether a technical proposal was required, who evaluated proposals and how long it took.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess contractor experience via references, previous work with Navy, on-site visits, and other relevant checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess accuracy of cost comparison process and common omissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Question whether the cost comparison process accurately reflects the cost of contracting out, and identify common shortcomings: performance/quality not accounted for; 4% administrative cost estimate is too low; litigation costs not accounted for; transition costs exceed 10% differential; costs for administering RIF procedures not accounted for; impact on productivity of remaining government workers not accounted for; other specified reasons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Require explanations for checked items to document rationale for judgment.
